run_fastapi_server: run the FastAPI quote display server on 0.0.0.0:8000 using uvicorn
display_quotes_html: post a QuoteSet to /display to render styled HTML of quotes with authors
check_server_health: get the /health endpoint to verify the quote display API is running
view_homepage: get the root / endpoint to see usage instructions and example JSON payload
generate_quote_html: call quote_html with a title and list of quote dicts to produce styled HTML
